$comment: Model id -> the route that ran the model (apps/web2 only; the web3 client apps/web does not read this file).
The id prefix before the first '/' decides. It mirrors services/runner/src/model-route.ts: 'opencode-go/' runs on opencode go;
every other TestMyAgent run goes to OpenRouter (an OpenRouter id starts with its author slug: 'anthropic/', 'z-ai/', 'qwen/').
The other prefixes name executors whose results come in through services/runner/src/bench-import.ts (they never run on the TMA runner).
